Only three source files name the `PlanLimits` type itself:

- **`src/config/plan-limits.ts`** declares the interface (line 13). It also names the type in the `PLAN_LIMITS` annotation, `Readonly<Record<PlanId, PlanLimits>>` (line 29), and in the return type of `getPlanLimits` (line 107). Each of the four plan entries in that object will also need a value for the new required field.
- **`src/components/domain/billing/billing-plan-card.tsx`** imports it with `type PlanLimits` (line 16) and uses it for the `limits: PlanLimits` prop (line 27).
- **`src/hooks/use-plan-limits.ts`** imports it with `type PlanLimits` (line 9) and uses it in the return type of `usePlanLimits()` (line 14).

About 30 other files use plan quotas, but they all go through `getPlanLimits()` and never write the type name, so they're out of scope. That includes the actions, services, jobs, pages, `src/lib/rate-limit.ts` and the tests. Some matches of the name only appear in comments, test descriptions, the manifest JSON or the manifest build scripts, and those don't count as naming the type either.

ANSWER: src/config/plan-limits.ts, src/components/domain/billing/billing-plan-card.tsx, src/hooks/use-plan-limits.ts
